about:
# No (C) Mark
Automatically removes the (C) mark on copied levels when uploading them

## Want to help?
Feel free to open a [Pull Request](https://github.com/M336G/NoCMark/pulls) on GitHub!

## Credits
- [StarlyGMD](https://gdbrowser.com/u/StarlyGMD) - for the mod idea
- [MegaHack](https://absolllute.com/store/mega_hack) - for the mod/name idea
changelog:
# 1.0.1
- Added a warning in the share level popup for when the (C) mark will be removed
- Fixed the original ID being removed in the editor when uploading a level where it would remove the (C) mark

# 1.0.0
- Initial release
